clue.text: Board includes a head, with educational potential

indicators.note: the board word takes the per-head word inside it, so includes signals one piece holding another

parts.note: a board is a table, as in board and lodging or a boardroom table
a head means per person, which is each, as in costing ten pounds a head

explanation.surface: A school board boasts that it includes a headteacher with real educational potential.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a head' looks like the headteacher of a school board; it means 'per person', as in ten pounds a head.
explanation.definitionFit: Something with educational potential is able to be taught, a direct paraphrase.

clue.text: Toddlers left group, in short

explanation.surface: Small children joining a left-wing faction, briefly.
explanation.walkthrough: TROTS is short for Trotskyists, a far-left group; a trot is also an old word for a toddling child.
explanation.definitionFit: A trot is a small child just learning to walk, and Trots is the clipped name for Trotskyist revolutionaries.

clue.text: Undistinguished person

parts.note: someone with no particular standing, just any old individual, as in being a nobody rather than somebody

explanation.definitionFit: Calling someone just anyone at all marks them as of no importance, the opposite of a somebody.

clue.text: Limp put an end to children's game

parts.note: to limp is to hop along on one good leg
to scotch a plan or rumour is to stop it dead

explanation.surface: Someone with a limp has had to stop playing a playground game.
explanation.walkthrough: SCOTCH means 'put an end to', as in scotching a rumour.
explanation.definitionFit: Hopscotch is a playground game of hopping through chalked squares.

clue.text: Post accepted by more wicked criminal

indicators.note: the post word is taken in by the comparative, so accepted by puts it inside

parts.note: black can mean evil, so more wicked is blacker
post is mail delivered by the postal service

explanation.surface: A letter is taken in by an even nastier lawbreaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'more wicked' suggests a villain comparing notes; black here means evil, as in a black deed.
explanation.definitionFit: An extortioner who threatens exposure for money is a kind of criminal.

clue.text: Once in Rome, I say nothing

parts.note: say introduces an example, abbreviated e.g.
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A traveller recalls that when once in Rome they said nothing at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Once in Rome' signals Latin: the Latin word for I.
explanation.definitionFit: In Latin, the language once spoken in Rome, the first-person pronoun is this word.

clue.text: A large number initially employed in Japanese plant

indicators.note: the setter uses this phrase to join the two pieces, with the article word set to work after the crowd word

parts.note: a host is a large number, as in a host of golden daffodils

explanation.surface: A great many people were first put to work in a factory in Japan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plant' looks like a factory employing people; it is a garden plant from Japan. The A comes first in the clue but last in the answer, which 'initially employed in' only loosely covers.
explanation.definitionFit: The plantain lily, a leafy shade perennial, originates in Japan and China.

clue.text: Book among those abridged

indicators.note: among says the letters lie within the words that follow, straddling them

explanation.surface: A book is found among those shortened editions.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'tHOSE Abridged'.
explanation.definitionFit: Hosea is one of the minor prophets of the Old Testament, a book of the Bible.

clue.text: On moral grounds, hold back very little

explanation.surface: Someone holds back only a tiny bit, on grounds of conscience.
explanation.walkthrough: A scruple is also an old apothecaries' weight of twenty grains, hence a tiny amount.
explanation.definitionFit: To hesitate from conscience is to have qualms, and the twenty-grain apothecaries' weight means a tiny quantity.

clue.text: Such a tale can do damage

definitions.text: Such a tale can do damage

indicators.note: to damage the words a tale can do is to wreck their order and rebuild them

explanation.surface: A warning that a piece of gossip can cause harm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damage' is the anagram signal on A TALE CAN DO; the whole clue describes the answer, a tale told from hearsay.
explanation.definitionFit: Hearsay stories, based on personal accounts rather than evidence, can spread harm.

clue.text: Love to play? I'm changing in games centre

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, the letter O

indicators.note: changing tells us the letters of play and I'm are being rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone loves to play, while changing at a sports venue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changing' looks like changing clothes at a sports centre; it rearranges PLAY and I'M into LYMPIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Olympia in Greece was the site of the ancient Olympic Games; it is also a London exhibition venue.

clue.text: Witness to make a statement

explanation.surface: A witness is called to give a statement in court.
explanation.definitionFit: To witness is to see or watch, and to remark or comment is another sense of the same verb.

clue.text: Resigned, thus, to cuts

indicators.note: the little word to cuts into the Latin word, splitting it

parts.note: sic is Latin for thus, used to mark a quotation as printed

explanation.surface: Someone resigned to job cuts, as it happens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cuts' looks like budget cuts that someone is resigned to; it is the containment signal. SIC is the Latin 'thus' that editors print after a quoted error.
explanation.definitionFit: A philosophical person accepts hardship without complaint, calmly resigned to fate.

clue.text: Novel written as child slept

parts.note: kid is informal for a child
napped means had a short sleep

explanation.surface: A story written while the youngster was asleep.
explanation.walkthrough: Robert Louis Stevenson's adventure novel, whose title also means abducted.
explanation.definitionFit: Stevenson's 1886 adventure story of David Balfour is a famous Scottish novel.

clue.text: Create a style, holding one title

parts.note: to design something is to create it

indicators.note: the style word holds the numeral inside, so holding signals containment

parts.note: ton is a dated word for fashionable style
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A fashion designer creates a look that contains a single title.
explanation.walkthrough: TON, borrowed from French, means fashion or style; it holds I.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal name or label given to someone or something is their title.

clue.text: I see why listeners get such a cold spell

indicators.note: listeners hear the words spoken, so what they hear is a sound-alike

parts.note: the three words spoken together run as three letter names

explanation.surface: Someone understands why the audience is catching chills in a frosty snap.
explanation.walkthrough: Said aloud, 'I see why' gives the letter names I, C, Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Freezing weather is extremely chilly, as of a frosty spell.

clue.text: Restless Simon wildly raised Cain

indicators.note: the letters are thrown about wildly, with raised Cain playing on the phrase for causing trouble

explanation.surface: Simon caused a terrible commotion because he could not settle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised Cain' is an idiom for making trouble; here SIMON and CAIN are jumbled.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who cannot sleep is restless at night, the noun used as a description.

clue.text: It's obvious partners in carriage don't exist

indicators.note: the bridge pair sits inside the carriage word

parts.note: a trap is a light two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage
North and South are partners at the bridge table
things that don't exist simply are not, contracted

explanation.surface: Plainly, some couples have no place in a horse-drawn vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge the two partnerships are North-South and East-West, so 'partners' can be NS. 'carriage' is an old horse-drawn TRAP, and 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something easily seen through is clear and plain, hence obvious.

clue.text: Genuine article held by female relative detailing 14ac

indicators.note: the article is held inside the relative word

parts.note: an aunt is a female relative
the is the definite article

indicators.note: detailing cuts off the tail, the final letter of the word

parts.note: 14 across is the word for frosty

explanation.surface: A real piece of writing by an aunt describes a cold snap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailing' means removing the tail: the answer to 14 across loses its last letter to give IC.
explanation.definitionFit: Something authentic is real and not fake.

clue.text: Boil, then ignite, to undergo conversion

parts.note: to seethe is to boil or bubble
to light is to ignite

explanation.surface: Instructions to heat something then set it alight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'conversion' looks like turning one thing into another; it is a religious conversion, a sudden understanding.
explanation.definitionFit: To be suddenly converted, especially to a faith, is to perceive the truth at last.

clue.text: Change to count, say — quarters and gold coin

parts.note: quarters are compass points, here East and North
the noble was an old English gold coin

explanation.surface: Converting to coinage, with quarters and a gold piece.
explanation.walkthrough: A count is a nobleman, so making someone a count ennobles them; the NOBLE was a medieval English gold coin.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise someone to the peerage is to make them a lord, such as a count.

clue.text: Old coin or note in foreign currency

explanation.surface: An antique coin or banknote in some foreign money.
explanation.walkthrough: The SOL was an old French coin, is the fifth note of the tonic sol-fa scale, and is the currency of Peru.
explanation.definitionFit: A French sou-type coin, the sol-fa note also called so, and the Peruvian monetary unit share this name.

clue.text: Like David in ill-matched contest, second last

parts.note: to last is to linger on

explanation.surface: David's unequal fight, mentioned second last.
explanation.walkthrough: David killed Goliath with a sling, so he was a slinger.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible David fought Goliath armed only with a sling and stone.

clue.text: Result of much rain — a crash in Eastern Region

indicators.note: a crash smashes the letters of much rain and a into a new order

explanation.surface: Heavy rainfall causes a crash in an eastern area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crash' looks like a car crash caused by rain; it rearranges MUCH RAIN into MANCHURI, with A at the end. 'Result of' joins.
explanation.definitionFit: Manchuria is a historical region of north-east China.

clue.text: Somewhat hard-headed, in practice

indicators.note: headed says the first letter of hard leads

parts.note: somewhat means a bit

explanation.surface: A rather stubborn person is in training.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hard-headed' reads as stubborn; split it: H heads A BIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A habit is a regular custom, which is one sense of practice.

clue.text: Little by little, a shrub appears

parts.note: Eric, or Little by Little is a Victorian school story by Frederic Farrar, so its subtitle stands for the name

explanation.surface: A bush slowly appears, bit by bit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Little by little' looks like 'gradually'; it is the subtitle of Farrar's 1858 school novel 'Eric, or Little by Little'.
explanation.definitionFit: Erica is the genus of heaths and heathers, low shrubs.

clue.text: A ringleader caught by detectives is bitter

indicators.note: the letter is caught inside the detectives' abbreviation

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police
the leader of ring is its first letter

explanation.surface: A gang boss arrested by the police is resentful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ringleader' looks like a gang boss; it is the first letter of 'ring', R.
explanation.definitionFit: Acrid means sharp and bitter in taste or smell.

clue.text: One fish in Mediterranean sank

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: the fish word goes inside the sea's abbreviation

parts.note: Med is the short name for the Mediterranean
the bib, or pouting, is a fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A single fish sank in the Med.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sank' means drank, as in sinking a pint, not went under.
explanation.definitionFit: To sink a drink is informal for downing it, so sank means drank.

clue.text: Stupid and lacking distinction

explanation.surface: Someone foolish and without any distinguishing features.
explanation.definitionFit: Dim means slow-witted, and also faint or indistinct, lacking clarity.

clue.text: Bury, for instance, inside hole, say

indicators.note: the abbreviation sits inside the burial word

parts.note: to inter is to bury
for instance is e.g.

explanation.surface: Bury, the Lancashire town, for example, has a hole inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hole, say' sounds like 'whole': a whole number. 'Bury' looks like the English town.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a whole number, and whole sounds like hole, so the definition plays on that sound.

clue.text: Split between Conservative and his opponents

parts.note: a Conservative's political opponents are the Left

explanation.surface: A divide between a Tory and his rivals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'between ... and' only orders the pieces: C, then LEFT.
explanation.definitionFit: A cleft is a split or fissure, like a cleft chin.

clue.text: Looked after hands — hence my success as doctor

definitions.text: Looked after hands — hence my success as doctor

parts.words: Looked after hands — hence my success as doctor
parts.note: a hand treatment, and split into four words a doctor's boast about a patient restored to health

explanation.walkthrough: Split as MAN I CURED it is a doctor's boast; whole it means nails tended.
explanation.definitionFit: Hands that have had a cosmetic nail treatment have been well cared for.
